_comment: Source of the app builds TAKTIK installs, newest first, and of the status of the adjusted versions (override_status: testing = under validation; adjusted = adjusted by the bot, run on none of our phones, no validation planned; absent = validated, which needs a validated build of that version). A validated build carries its validation block (the Lab runs that prove it, the decision, the known limits), recorded by python scripts/audits/audit_compatibility_file.py --promote from the desktop app's npm run lab:exit -- --promote, never by hand. COMPATIBILITY.md and the desktop app's version lists are generated from this file: python scripts/audits/audit_compatibility_file.py --write

exception.reason: Instagram account of a client: no DM thread opened, no typing in a field, no story viewed, no recent search left, and no answer to Instagram's contacts access dialog (so Discover people is never entered)

notes.fr: Un passage du Lab du 30/09 sur le Pixel 6a, Instagram en français, qui porte le compte d'un client : joué sans les 23 actions de son exception (aucun fil de messages ouvert, aucune frappe, aucune story vue, aucune recherche laissée, « Découvrir des personnes » jamais ouvert). Quatre échecs connus de la 447 : lecture des commentaires et de leurs auteurs, état et ouverture d'une ligne d'une liste d'abonnés. Aucun passage n'est vert au sens strict de lab:exit (fait sur le commit validé) : c'est la décision du mainteneur qui valide, avec ces preuves et ces limites. versionCode et ABI : ceux de l'APK tiré de ce téléphone le 26/09 ; le rapport ne les relevait pas encore.
notes.en: One Lab run of 2026-09-30 on the Pixel 6a, Instagram in French, which holds a client's account: played without the 23 actions of its exception (no message thread opened, no typing, no story viewed, no search left behind, Discover people never opened). Four known failures of 447: reading the comments and their authors, the state and the opening of a row of a followers list. No run is green in the strict sense of lab:exit (made on the validated commit): the maintainer's decision validates, with this evidence and these limits. versionCode and ABI: those of the APK pulled from this phone on 2026-09-26; the report did not record them yet.
